tasks.title: Write and say an invented name
tasks.objective: Combine the module language in a short supported written exchange and a spoken repair task.
tasks.context:
Copy Bonjour. Then write Je m’appelle followed by an invented first name. Write its letters separately. Keep any accent in the name. Supported example: Bonjour. Je m’appelle Léa. L – É – A. The example is a model, not the only acceptable name. Say the greeting and name, then ask the Tutor to repeat slowly. Human listening is needed to judge letter pronunciation.

Review criteria: Check the greeting, name phrase and letter sequence; copy first, then retrieve tomorrow without looking.

No objective correctness, independent human approval or CEFR score is claimed.
